correctness.rationale: The full-dimensional chainlink polytope is defined by coordinate and cyclic-difference halfspaces with 2ell<=min a_i and s>=3. Explicit feasible witnesses show coordinate support extrema 0,a_i and difference extremes -a_(i+1),a_i-ell. Reflection containment reduces exactly to 0<=u_i<=(lambda-1)a_i and u_i-u_(i+1)<=(lambda-1)a_i-lambda ell. The difference-constraint digraph has only cycles through a proper contiguous directed ring run and the full directed ring (plus nonnegative two-arcs), giving lambda=max(A/(A-s ell), A_(i,m)/(A_(i,m)-m ell)). All denominators are positive. Shortest-path potentials attain the sharp bound and describe all centers. Homogeneous specialization yields a genuine center segment. For ell=2 the (4,4,20,20) and (4,20,4,20) ratios are 4/3 and 6/5. Independent rational barrier LP and support inequalities were checked for 3/4 dimensions; finite checks are corroboration, not the all-parameter proof.
